notes: v1.2.0 accepts PR #14 and hardens implement-hook dispatch to Spec Kit 0.16.4 semantics: mandatory hooks emit EXECUTE_COMMAND, are actually invoked and awaited, and mandatory after_implement hooks complete before handoff status becomes complete. It also fixes Issue #13 by replacing GNU-only realpath missing-path handling with a portable, symlink-aware Bash helper. Spec Kit 0.16.4 and Superpowers 6.3.0 are the audited development baselines. No command, registered hook, state file, schema, guard rule, actor semantic, stable-alias URL, or >=0.8.10 runtime-floor change.
